unverified.detail: Not yet recorded; awaiting a run of the Record workflow against the live, public, credential-free API.

spec.description: Recent trades on one market, newest first.

request.title: GetTransactionsRequest
request.description: The market to fetch trades for, and how far back to look.

time.description: How far back to return trades from. Defaults to `hour`.

response.title: TransactionList
response.description: Trades in the requested window, newest first.

tid.description: Trade id. Monotonically increasing but never used arithmetically, so it stays a plain string.

amount.description: Trade amount, in the base currency.

type.description: Side of the taker order: `0` buy, `1` sell.

notes: No pagination block: `time` only widens or narrows the trailing window this call returns in one shot -- there is no cursor or offset to walk pages with, and no documented way to reach a trade older than the window allows.
